description: Source code for ADC driver implementation in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including initialization, configuration, DMA handling, and group control functions.

methods.name: Adc_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes ADC and DMA, sets state to uninitialized.

methods.name: Adc_Init
methods.description: Initializes ADC with configuration, sets up DMA, calibration, and state.

methods.name: Adc_SetupResultBuffer
methods.description: Configures result buffer for a specific ADC group and updates DMA accordingly.

methods.name: Adc_ReadGroup
methods.description: Reads data from an ADC group, handles continuous and one-shot modes.

methods.name: Adc_Group0ConversionComplete
methods.description: DMA transfer complete ISR, updates group status and calls callback if enabled.

methods.name: Adc_StartGroupConversion
methods.description: Starts ADC group conversion, configures channels and sets group to busy.

methods.name: Adc_EnableGroupNotification
methods.description: Enables notification callback for a group.

methods.name: Adc_DisableGroupNotification
methods.description: Disables notification callback for a group.

methods.name: Adc_GetGroupStatus
methods.description: Returns current status of an ADC group.
